localChanges: On the city screen, Previous city and Next city buttons, and the Left and Right arrow keys, now step through your cities without closing the screen (closes #678).
A Rename button on the city screen gives one of your cities a new name, of up to 12 letters, as in Civ1 (closes #676).
Each improvement you can sell has its own Sell button on the city screen, instead of its name underlining when you point at it (closes #684).
